title: Blind Discovery: Chicane Obstacle Traversal
goal_description: Discover control parameters enabling smooth traversal through chicane obstacles without timeout or collision.

hypotheses.title: Increasing Repulsion Gain for Obstacle Avoidance
hypotheses.statement: Increasing the repulsion gain will make the robot more responsive to the obstacles, potentially leading to a smoother traversal.
hypotheses.mechanism: The repulsion gain influences how strongly the robot avoids obstacles, which can affect its path planning and traversal speed.

hypotheses.title: Reducing Safety Margin to Increase Speed
hypotheses.statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to move closer to the obstacles, potentially increasing its speed and reducing the time to traverse the chicane.
hypotheses.mechanism: A smaller safety margin means the robot can approach the obstacles more closely, which can be beneficial for faster traversal.
